papers.title_en: Walk This Way: Crocs and the Impact of Heel Strap Utilization on Overground Walking Performance and Lower Limb Joint Kinematics.
papers.title_zh: 卡骆驰后跟带使用对地面步行表现及下肢关节运动学的影响
papers.tldr_en: The ankle kinematics suggest that when worn without a heel strap, Crocs negatively impact ankle mechanics and impact lower limb kinematics, and sports mode significantly improved walking velocity and stride length compared with comfort mode and control conditions while walking.
papers.abstract_en: Gait kinematics undergo significant alterations stemming from shoe type that can enhance performance or result in musculoskeletal injuries that impact daily living. Crocs surge to mainstream consumers, along with their presence throughout other industries, begs the question of the impact of this shoe on walking performance and kinematics. This study examined the impact of Crocs with and without heel strap on walking performance and lower body kinematics. Thirty-one participants completed 3 walking trials at self-selected pace for each condition: control (CON): socked; sports mode: Crocs with heel strap; and comfort mode: Crocs without heel strap. Inertial measurement units were used to calculate sagittal kinematics of the hip, knee, and ankle. papers.title_en: Comparison of resistance training using barbell half squats and trap bar deadlifts on maximal strength, power performance, and lean mass in recreationally active females: an eight-week randomised trial
papers.title_zh: 杠铃半深蹲与六角杠硬拉抗阻训练对休闲活动女性最大力量、爆发力表现和去脂体重的影响比较：一项为期八周的随机试验
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: The findings suggests that in recreationally active females, exercise selection is less of a concern provided that heavy loads are applied, and relevant muscle groups are targeted.
papers.abstract_en: Background The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of high load resistance training using barbell half squats compared with trap bar deadlifts on maximal strength, power performance, and lean mass in recreationally active females. Methods Twenty-two recreationally active female participants (age: 26.9 ± 7.7 yrs.; height: 166.0 ± 5.1 cm; weight: 68.6 ± 9.9 kg) were randomly assigned to either a barbell half squat group (SG: n  = 10) or trap bar deadlift group (DG: n  = 12). Training consisted of twice-weekly sessions for eight weeks. Both groups completed one-repetition maximum (1RM) testing for both barbell half squat and trap bar deadlift groups. Countermovement jump (CMJ) and sprint performance were also assessed. Total body (TBLM) and leg lean mass (LLM) were measured with dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry. papers.title_en: A Synchronized Multi-IMU Wearable System for Tracking of Joint-Angles in Sports Motion Analysis With Reference-Based Validation and Dynamic Task Characterization
papers.title_zh: 一种用于运动动作分析中关节角度跟踪的同步多惯性测量单元可穿戴系统，具备基于参考的验证和动态任务表征
papers.abstract_en: Reliable joint-angle measurement outside laboratory environments is important for posture assessment and technique analysis in sports and rehabilitation. Yet, wearable IMU systems, despite being the most practical solution, remain constrained by drift, multisensor timing consistency, validation, and cost. This paper presents a synchronized, cost-efficient, modular IMU wearable platform and an end-to-end pipeline for joint-angle estimation tailored to high-dynamic sports motion analysis. The system combines high-rate sensing with robust local logging, a Real Time Clock-disciplined microsecond timestamping scheme for inter-node synchronization, an indirect Kalman filter-based orientation estimator followed by relative-rotation joint-angle extraction, high-pass drift mitigation, and range normalization. papers.title_en: MoCap-Impute: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Comparative Analysis of Imputation Methods for IMU-based Motion Capture Data
papers.title_zh: MoCap-Impute：基于惯性测量单元动作捕捉数据插补方法的全面基准测试与比较分析
papers.tldr_en: This work proposes a systematic comparative analysis of imputation techniques, including statistical, machine learning, and deep learning techniques, for time series data of IMU-derived MoCap data, and introduces the first publicly available MoCap dataset specifically for the purpose of benchmarking missing value imputation.
papers.abstract_en: Motion capture (MoCap) data derived from wearable Inertial Measurement Units is essential to applications in sports science and healthcare robotics. However, a significant amount of the potential of this data is limited due to missing data derived from sensor limitations, network issues, and environmental interference. Such limitations can introduce bias, prevent the fusion of critical data streams, and ultimately compromise the integrity of human activity analysis. Despite the plethora of data imputation techniques available, there have been few systematic performance evaluations of these techniques explicitly for the time series data of IMU-derived MoCap data. We address this by evaluating the imputation performance across three distinct contexts: univariate time series, multivariate across players, and multivariate across kinematic angles. papers.abstract_zh: 源自可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU）的动作捕捉（MoCap）数据对于运动科学和医疗机器人应用至关重要。然而，由于传感器限制、网络问题和环境干扰导致的缺失数据，这些数据的巨大潜力受到限制。这些限制可能引入偏差，阻碍关键数据流的融合，并最终损害人类活动分析的完整性。尽管有大量数据插补技术可用，但对这些技术的系统性能评估却很少见...

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 面向未来：离心抗阻训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心抗阻训练被认为是增强成年人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不明确。目的 本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心抗阻训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法 从电子搜索引擎检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章...

papers.title_en: The Biomechanical Influence of Step Width on Typical Locomotor Activities: A Systematic Review
papers.title_zh: 步幅宽度对典型运动活动的生物力学影响：一项系统综述
papers.tldr_en: A systematic review of published findings to determine the influence of acute changes in step width on locomotion biomechanics and provide implications for injury prevention and enhanced sports performance found that increasing step width may be beneficial for specific injury rehabilitation.
papers.abstract_en: Step width is a spatial variable in the frontal plane, defined as the mediolateral distance between the heel (forefoot during sprinting) of bilateral feet at initial contact. Variations in step width may impact the lower limb biomechanics. This systematic review aimed to synthesize the published findings to determine the influence of acute changes in step width on locomotion biomechanics and provide implications for injury prevention and enhanced sports performance. Literature was identified, selected, and appraised in accordance with the methods of a systematic review. Four electronic databases (Web of Science, MEDLINE via PubMed, Scopus, and ScienceDirect) were searched up until May 2023 with the development of inclusion criteria based on the PICO model.
